subject: Request: short-term capacity credit + review of rate tiers for April launch
messages:
From: Tim O'Leary <tim.oleary@brightdesk.com>
To: michael_grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@brightdesk.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch week — short-term capacity & credit request

Hi Michael,

Quick context: BrightDesk is launching a major feature on April 15 that will spike API usage for ~72 hours. We ran a staging load test and expect peak token throughput ~3.4x our committed tier for three days (see attached CSV for hourly estimates).

We'd like to request:
- A temporary uplift to our rate limits for Apr 14–17 (to avoid 429s)
- A one-time usage credit or grossly reduced overrun rate for that window (our budget for the launch is tight)

Can Redwood offer a short-term burst support package (credits + elevated rate tier) and confirm any operational steps (IP allow-listing, recommended batching config) so we don't hit circuit breakers?

If you need a procurement contact, loop in Sara Patel (copied) — she'll handle PO/contract steps.

Thanks,
Tim
Director of Product
BrightDesk

Attachments: brightdesk-expected-usage-april.csv

From: michael_grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Tim O'Leary <tim.oleary@brightdesk.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 12:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch week — short-term capacity & credit request

Hi Tim — thanks for the detail and the CSV. Congrats on the launch.

We can support a short-term uplift. Proposed path: 
- Temporary rate-tier bump to your "S-2" tier for April 14 00:00 PDT through April 16 23:59 PDT. That increases your per-minute concurrency and token throughput caps by 300%.
- One-time overrun credit: Redwood can apply a $12k gross credit against overage usage for that window. Alternatively, we can reduce the overrun rate to $0.0025/token for any usage billed to the uplift window — whichever procurement prefers.

Operational notes:
- We recommend enabling prefix KV caching for common prompts and using continuous batching to reduce peak token volume.
- IP allow-listing and a short-lived canary route (we can provide a route ID) — our infra team will monitor and hold emergency rollback controls.

I've attached a draft temporary credit memo and a simple rate-tiering spreadsheet for transparency. Ben — can you confirm if this range needs commercial approval or if we can sign off under the regional deal desk? Marissa — FYI for invoicing/true-up flow.

Tim — if this is acceptable, Sara/Procurement can confirm and we will push a DocuSign SOW and route the credit.

Best,
Michael Grant
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: redwood-temporary-credit-draft.pdf, rate-tiering-proposal.xlsx

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: michael_grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch week — short-term capacity & credit request

Looping in the deal desk rules: A one-time $12k credit fits within my sign-off authority for named accounts, but the reduced overrun rate option needs VP approval because it changes published pricing incentives.

Suggest we take this approach: commit to the temporary uplift + $12k credit in the SOW now to unblock the launch. Parallel path: I'll route the reduced overrun rate ("$0.0025/token") as an internal pricing exception memo for approval — if approved before the run window we'll apply retroactively to the event. If not approved, the $12k credit still stands.

Marissa — we need to confirm how the credit shows on the invoice and whether it hits the current billing period or is applied as a post-invoice adjustment (customer prefers credit applied to Apr invoice). Also need confirmation on measurement windows: we'll bill based on UTC usage but cap the uplift to the dates Michael specified.

Ben
Senior Director, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@brightdesk.com>
To: michael_grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Tim O'Leary <tim.oleary@brightdesk.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@brightdesk.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch week — short-term capacity & credit request

Thanks Michael/Ben — procurement confirms the approach and prefers the $12k credit applied to the April invoice (post-invoice adjustment is fine).

Action items for Redwood:
- Send a short SOW or addendum that outlines the uplift window (Apr 14–16 PST), the credit amount, and whether the reduced-overrun-rate will be pursued as an approval path.
- Provide the DocuSign link and the billing contact details we should reference on the invoice.

We need invoices addressed to: BrightDesk Inc., Attn: AP, 420 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94104. PO will be routed once SOW is signed.

Sara Patel
Head of Procurement
BrightDesk

From: michael_grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@brightdesk.com>, Tim O'Leary <tim.oleary@brightdesk.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch week — short-term capacity & credit request

Sara — thanks. Attaching the finalized SOW addendum and DocuSign link below. Key points in the addendum:
- Uplift window: 2027-04-14 00:00 PDT — 2027-04-16 23:59 PDT
- Temporary tier bump: S-2 equivalent, concurrency and throughput caps x3
- Credit: $12,000 to be applied as a post-invoice adjustment to the Apr 2027 invoice
- Measurement: usage measured in UTC; true-up will include the uplift window only
- Operational runbook: we will provide a short runbook and a dedicated Slack channel to Redwood on-call for the window

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/REDWOOD-BD-041
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/BD-2027-041

Marissa — please set billing contact on the SOW to BrightDesk AP address Sara supplied and flag this for April invoicing. Ben — please proceed with pricing-exception routing for the reduced overrun rate; we will apply retroactively if approved.

If there are no further edits, we'll send the DocuSign now.

Regards,
Michael Grant
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-temporary-credit-final-sow.pdf
